title: citation-ready: a structural citability check for AI answer engines
description:
A dependency-free command-line tool that checks a web page for the structural signals observed on content that AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) tend to quote and recommend.

These are observed correlations, not guarantees. A high score means a page looks like the pages that get cited; it does not promise a citation. The only way to know whether an engine actually cites a page is to measure it.

Python standard library only. Runs offline in mock mode by default.
